models_evaluated: transformer-UNet + LSTM hybrid deep learning model on dynamic DSA radiomics

links.outcome: Discrimination for predicting pulmonary embolism, AI model versus Wells score
links.effect: AUC 0.88 (95% CI 0.85-0.92) for the AI model vs 0.76 (95% CI 0.70-0.83) for Wells score; P = .026.
links.quote: The AI model demonstrated significantly superior discriminative performance for predicting PE compared with the Wells score (area under the curve, 0.88; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.85-0.92 vs 0.76; 95% CI, 0.70-0.83; P = .026).

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an AI model on dynamic DSA radiomics to predict pulmonary embolism and simulate/associate with clinical decision-making, but does not prospectively evaluate a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
